entries.original_goal: Evaluate accelerated portable/platform SHA and safe immutable-sector validation reuse.
entries.delivered: Optional OpenSSL full-payload SHA outside Windows, existing CNG and full portable restart/fallback.
entries.remaining: The selected accelerated full-verification contract is delivered; immutable-sector reuse was not implemented or globally exhausted.
entries.audit_basis: Provider/failure/fallback checks and parity pass. Earlier balanced Linux launches show bounded 12.4/13.8% wall and 40.2/41.1% process-CPU reductions; not an FPS or Windows claim.
entries.next_closure: Keep full corruption detection and fallback; revisit immutable reuse separately only with complete ownership proof.

entries.name: Resident-media representation
entries.original_goal: Evaluate lower-copy/raw-versus-user-data residency, bounded mapped/shared storage and memory footprint.
entries.delivered: Read-only mapped first-data-track residency with bounded copied fallback.
entries.remaining: The selected lower-private-copy representation is delivered; this does not exhaust all raw/user-sector representation alternatives.
entries.audit_basis: Current mappedBytes 139735888 and privateResidentBytes 0 remove the separate private copy. Mapping length is not a measured RSS saving.
entries.next_closure: Retain 256 MiB bound, raw/audio/movie readers and allocation/mapping-failure fallback.

entries.name: Reusable console-firmware services
entries.original_goal: Assess closed standard Sega CD BIOS services that can be replaced once for supported firmware profiles across games.
entries.delivered: Native BIOS instruction catalog retained; no new reusable whole-service HLE.
entries.remaining: A named standard firmware service ABI with complete reusable effects.
entries.audit_basis: Catalog execution is not service HLE. A gameplay-only profile does not cover boot, BRAM/UI or firmware control waits; title file/SP routines remain excluded.
entries.next_closure: Find a costly standard firmware service and specify its complete ABI/effects before replacing it; do not move a title routine into engine code.

entries.name: Engine snapshot representation and identity
entries.original_goal: Evaluate generic authoritative/derived state separation, dirty pages/deltas/checkpoints and exact incremental state identity.
entries.delivered: Existing authoritative section table and full-byte checksum retained.
entries.remaining: Generic writer ownership, dirty pages/deltas/checkpoints and exact incremental identity.
entries.audit_basis: rb_state.c is unchanged. Dominant title fiber payload is outside scope, but does not rule out generic representation work. Old save-state compatibility is not required.
entries.next_closure: Establish complete writer/restore ownership and current per-section cost before choosing a generic page/delta representation.

entries.name: Serializer and snapshot storage
entries.original_goal: Reuse bounded buffers, serialize into owned storage and reduce generic snapshot allocation/copy/thumbnail work.
entries.delivered: Existing snapshot ownership/atomic-save implementation retained.
entries.remaining: Generic transactional borrow/capacity/commit storage or pooling where useful.
entries.audit_basis: rbe_snap_ring_store owns the blob on success, so malloc is not an immediate-copy leak. A new transactional storage contract is feasible shared engine work.
entries.next_closure: If allocation/copy cost warrants it, serialize into reserved owned capacity without destroying the previous entry on failure.

entries.name: Discarded-replay engine work
entries.original_goal: Remove remaining purely derived shared rendering/publication preparation from replay that produces no visible output.
entries.delivered: Discarded cartridge replay already omits derived image work while retaining authoritative status/audio.
entries.remaining: No remaining shared cartridge image work demonstrated at this base; title publication remains separate and CD work is E09.
entries.audit_basis: Existing resim hooks/machine frame path establish this bounded terminal finding; current replay checks pass. No new gain is counted.
entries.next_closure: Retain current-build replay/state correctness; reopen for newly demonstrated shared derived work.

entries.name: Host presentation/deadline pipeline
entries.original_goal: Consolidate shared pacing, upload/present queue behavior and remaining compositor/CD coarse-wait costs.
entries.delivered: Previously delivered cartridge D3D11/high-resolution pacing retained.
entries.remaining: Further shared presentation/upload/UI ownership and CD pacing consolidation.
entries.audit_basis: presentation.c is unchanged and CD still uses coarse SDL_Delay. Blind sleep/spin reuse is not a qualified solution; no new physical delivery comparison was made.
entries.next_closure: Reuse beads-hj4v. Select an actual delivery/jitter or copy cost and implement a suitable shared pipeline/nonspinning fallback.

entries.name: Asynchronous engine persistence and diagnostics
entries.original_goal: Buffer immutable save/evidence/capture data and use bounded rings for enabled tracing instead of hot-path file I/O.
entries.delivered: Existing dirty-tracked/minute-rate evidence and opt-in tracing retained.
entries.remaining: Async immutable persistence or bounded trace rings for an enabled costly workload.
entries.audit_basis: No default hot file stall is demonstrated. This is a reasonable low-priority deferral, not an implemented asynchronous pipeline.
entries.next_closure: Reuse beads-3vb.11; pursue a measured enabled trace/save stall and retain transactional saves, shutdown/error handling.

entries.name: Whole-program native build optimization
entries.original_goal: Evaluate common LTO/PGO, cross-TU inlining, hot/cold layout and qualified optional kernels on real built consumers.
entries.delivered: Generated catalog compaction under ordinary linking, shared with E02.
entries.remaining: Actual matched LTO/PGO/cross-TU/hot-cold layout evaluation and qualification.
entries.audit_basis: Compaction is not an LTO/PGO experiment. No qualified new compiler alternative was delivered; noisy catalog CPU timing does not decide compiler optimization.
entries.next_closure: Use a supported compiler package on built consumers; retain exact arithmetic/portability and record runtime/startup/memory. Benchmark host waiting is not a global blocker.
